title: F04: Validation + review status
milestone: M3 Extraction pipeline
labels: backend
---
## Goal
Deterministic validation of extracted receipts, the plausibility rule for non-receipts, and a rule-based review status. Pure functions in `app/domain/`; F05 applies them after extraction and F06 after every edit.

**Depends on:** F02 (parallel with F03, F07)
**Built by:** `backend-dev`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `validation.py`: German number parser, currency normalisation, date parsing (`YYYY-MM-DD`, `DD.MM.YYYY`), item-sum check (±0.02), date checks; no tax check
- [ ] `confidence.py`: missing-field, `unreadable` and `uncategorized_item` flags; `accepted` / `needs_review` / `rejected`; `is_plausible_receipt`; `assess`
- [ ] Table-driven tests cover each rule and flag code in `backend/domain-logic.md`, with boundaries (0.02 vs 0.03, today, tomorrow, exactly 2 years)
- [ ] Tests on the recorded fixtures: `valid_receipt`, `missing_fields` (implausible), `non_receipt_claimed_receipt` (plausible, but flagged)
- [ ] An edited expense rerun through `assess` clears the fixed flag
- [ ] The review status is a string Literal matching `api.schemas.ReviewStatus`; no numeric score exists
- [ ] `app/domain/` imports nothing from `db`, `ai` or `api` (import-linter green)
- [ ] `backend/uncertainty.md` matches the implemented thresholds and flag codes
